build_note: The M11 port benchmark: libsodium-core 1.3.1 (Sodium.Core), the .NET binding of libsodium, a netstandard2.0 and 2.1 library in C# 9 (37 files, 3.7k lines) over a shared project of 73 P/Invoke declarations (src/Interop, 26 files), with 230 NUnit tests on net6.0 (4.3k lines). Its native dependency is the point (D-82): the C# loads libsodium 1.0.18 from the libsodium NuGet package, the C++ the port writes includes sodium.h and links the library, so the run's image is the port image with Ubuntu 22.04's libsodium-dev (1.0.18) added (bench/images/libsodium). The project checks integer overflow (CheckForOverflowUnderflow).
